### Trust in God Alone - Truth For Life - June 29
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-june-29-2022.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 32:31
Points:
- Hezekiah's growing self-reliance and pride led God to withdraw His active grace to test his heart.
- Even the most devoted believer would quickly fall into deep sin if left entirely to themselves.
- Believers possess no spiritual light of their own and depend wholly on God's sustaining grace.
- Christians must continually ask God to uphold and keep them through every stage and circumstance of life.
